$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons. Labels and explanations are shared by both variants, so they use variant-neutral terms.

templates.headline: Before you top up your finance
templates.body: A top-up usually refinances what you owe today and can extend your term. A longer term lowers the instalment but raises the total you repay. You can compare terms in the app, or ask us, before you continue.

templates.headline: قبل زيادة تمويلك
templates.body: زيادة التمويل تعني عادةً إعادة تمويل المبلغ المستحق اليوم، وقد تمدّد المدة. المدة الأطول تخفّض القسط لكنها ترفع إجمالي ما تسدده. يمكنك مقارنة المدد في التطبيق أو سؤالنا قبل المتابعة.
